think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any in-range numeric value is designated to switch modes/disable a feature (e.g., -1, 0) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) Determine whether such a value breaks the natural numeric ordering by causing a qualitatively different function. 4) If yes, mark as special and record the special value(s); otherwise mark as not special.
